question: Why the plans' naval bomber want came out more negative.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_ComputePlanForces
addresses.comment: **The force planner every AI country's theatre takes, and what fills the save's `min`.** 0x4B5210-0x4B60EC (`ret 4`), chosen by slot 73 where played_countries_array[country] is 0. brigadeDemand = divisions_needed (+0x354) x 3 + invasion_brigade_need (+0x370); totalBrigades = the sum of +0x40 (regiment count) over the units of +0x11C. A zeroed vector<int> of GetNumberOfSubUnits() entries then gets six aircraft wants, each only where technology_status->unit_available[type] and SubUnitDefinitionIsUsableBy admit the type: transport_plane += round(sum of transport_weight/1000 over +0x16C's armies / (transport_capability/1000)); tactical_bomber (cas where tactical is not available) += (totalBrigades + brigadeDemand) / 40, truncated; strategic_bomber += round(s) where s = sum over +0x18C of (LOCAL_IC + current_producing crude_oil)/1000, / 300, halved where +0x90 is non-empty, and only where s > 0; naval_bomber = round(score) (a plain store); multi_role += round(0.5 x tactical + 0.5 x score + 0.5 x transport planes); interceptor += (totalBrigades + brigadeDemand) / 40. The score: +0.07 / +0.15 / +0.02 per brigade - **one of the three, an else-if chain** (heavy_cruiser, else is_capital (+0x2F), else anything but a **submarine**; 0x4B5BF2, and 0x4B5E38 for the own side; read 2026-11-14, FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 78 - heavy_cruiser.txt carries capital = yes, and counts 0.07 alone) of each unit on +0x25C (sightings gained) **that is an enemy** (at war, REB either way, or covered by an undeclared war), and -0.07 / -0.15 / -0.02 per brigade (anything but a **transport_ship** for the last) of **every** unit on +0x26C (sightings lost), with no enemy test - so at peace it is only ever 0 or negative. Rounding is fistp, to nearest even. Posts CSetPlanForcesCommand only where the vector's length or any entry differs from the plan's min; never CSetPlanAttributesCommand. **Checked against the saves**: of the 58 entries only index 29 (interceptor), 39 (naval_bomber) and 53 (tactical_bomber) are ever non-zero in the 106 AI theatre plans; interceptor and tactical are equal but where the technology is missing (FIN and GRE hold no single_engine_aircraft_design and want neither, POR lacks twin_engine_aircraft_design and wants an interceptor only); naval_bomber is negative in exactly 9 theatres, all of countries holding nav_development; and floor(brigades under the HQ / 40) never exceeds the interceptor want where the type is available.
addresses.evidence: The two loops disassembled; the plans' min set beside the hourly saves.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_AssignSeaTargetsToAgents
addresses.comment: **Hands every enemy convoy, enemy fleet, enemy war-industry province, recent raid on our convoys and friendly fleet to one of the country's unit agents.** Read whole on the listing, 0x48C140 to the single `ret 4` at 0x48D551. One caller, ProcessAI at 0x4899B9, at hour id % 24, for every country with a CEU3AI (before the played/AI branch split). No intelligence, sighting or detection is consulted anywhere: every unit of the countries listed counts, wherever it is. (1) The enemy list: CCountryList_AppendAll of `enemies` (+0x1008) and `undeclared_war_opponents` (+0x1018), then every tag of the strategy's WarTargets (CCountry +0x5D4) not already on it. (2) Every unit agent (ai +0x40): submarine_want (+0xD8) = 0; the lists +0x24C, +0x25C, +0x26C and +0x284 freed and zeroed; the vector +0x18C emptied. An agent's theatre is its root's area id (+0x68/+0x6C) resolved through FindPersistentById; its slot 65 is `mov al,1` on CAIUnit. (3) For each enemy on the list that is in the scenario (+0x44): (a) **each of its convoys** (CCountry +0xA0): c = CConvoy::GetDesiredTransports; for each agent whose theatre has ports (CTheatre +0x9C > 0): over every (path province of the convoy, port of the theatre +0x94) pair with NavalDistanceTo(port, province)/1000 < 3000: sumBase += port's naval base level_max/1000, sumDist += that distance; agents with sumBase >= 1.0 get the convoy's id appended to their +0x24C (every such agent, not only the best); score = max((want + c)/20/sumBase, 1.0) x sumDist/portCount, want being the agent's +0xD8 so far; the agent with the strictly lowest score (from 1e7, first of equals in agent order) gets +0xD8 += c. (b) **each of its naval units** (+0xBAC, slot 16 IsNaval): per agent, over the theatre's ports with NavalDistanceTo(fleet province, port)/1000 <= 2000: sumDist, sumBase (naval base level_max/1000) and n; needs sumBase >= 1 and n >= 1; score = max((CAIUnit_CountAssignedEnemyShips(agent) + fleet's ships)/sumBase, 1.0) x sumDist/n, x 0.2 (double 0x160A260) where our acting capital's area is a real area (slot 0) on the theatre's area list (+0x84); the lowest, first of equals, gets the fleet's id on +0x25C. (c) **war-industry provinces**: in the enemy's acting capital's area (a real area), each province whose owner is its controller and is hostile to us (at war, either side REB, or an undeclared war covering it - IsEnemy inlined) and which works at least one level of industry (the province's building of g_CBuildingDataBase +0x2C, level_current +0x24 >= 1000) or produces at least 1 crude oil (+0x27C >= 1000); weight 2.0 where it carries a real strategic resource (+0x18, slot 14), else 1.0; per agent, over every air base (COwnerArea +0x58) of every area of the theatre within CMap::DistanceBetweenProvinces 800: sumBase += air base level_current/1000, sumDist += d; needs sumBase >= 1; score = sumDist/sumBase/weight; the lowest, first of equals, gets the province pushed on +0x18C. (4) **Raids on our convoys**: the game state's finished-battle list (+0xB80, walked through CCombatHistoryEntry +0x28) - each entry of kind 2 (naval) with is_convoy_battle (+0x20) set, a defender (+0x18/+0x1C) that is real, not REB, and our side (CCountry::IsSameSide, or co_belligerent and not an enemy), whose tick plus one month (AddMonths) is not before now: every agent with a theatre port within NavalDistanceTo 2000 of the battle province and CCountry_IsSeaRouteOpen(us, port, province, false) gets the province on +0x284 (CAIUnit_AddConvoyRaidProvince), once per agent. (5) **Friendly fleets**: every naval unit of every country on our non_hostile_countries (+0xF98: ourselves and co-belligerents not at war with us) goes to the agent with the lowest mean NavalDistanceTo (ports within 2000, sumBase >= 1, n >= 1) x 0.2 on the capital's theatre - no load term - and its id onto +0x26C. (6) Every agent's +0xD8 = +0xD8 / 20, truncated toward zero. The name is ours. **The two reaches, read 2026-11-14** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 78): enemy fleets (0x48C91D) and own fleets (0x48D340) both skip a port more than 2000.0 away (`comisd dist, 2000.0; ja`), so 2000 counts, and both need the ports' naval base levels to reach 1.0 (0x48C988, 0x48D3AB).
addresses.evidence: The comparisons and their constants read on the running game.
